$comment: The KernelSU late-load build this target pairs with. CI rebuilds it
from the src/kernelsu submodule; nothing is committed as a binary.
'id' names the published assets (ksud-<id>, kernelsu-<id>.ko). Targets that
load the same module share one id and are built once.
'kernelRelease' is the exact UTS release the module must report in its
vermagic. The DDK image ships its own release string, so the build
overwrites the generated utsrelease.h and kernel.release with this value
Built, audited and loaded. The first android13-5.15 module in the
repository was built from this image tag with the common patch set at
v3.3.0 -- module version 32601, manager constants compiled in for
org.witaqua.pwn.kernelsu -- audited against the target's own vmlinux
(0 missing symbols, 0 CRC mismatches, no __version entries; kallsyms
resolves the rest at load time) and loaded on the device through ksud's
late-load, after which the manager showed 32601-2 and ksud put SELinux
back to Enforcing. patchSets stayed empty as expected: HyperOS has no
KDP/RKP/DEFEX. The target's kernelVersion is null only because the
device's /proc/version has not been captured yet; filling it in is what
puts this pair in the job a release waits on.
